scope: Headless GUT shutdown after all project tests. Raw counts include Godot-held global script classes; they may only be recalibrated after an audited pinned GF vendor-tree or project runtime class-set change, and must not grow while both inputs remain unchanged.
calibration_reason: Thirteen audited runtime script classes raise the project class set from 201 to 214: accessibility summaries, generic competition/session metadata, deterministic hints, virtual input pulses, replay markers, tile motion profiles, shader/VFX drivers, and responsive task-page layout. The complete suite expands from 39/337 to 50/409 scripts/tests. This recalibration changes only the declared project class-set count; the existing ObjectDB, Resource, and RID ceilings remain unchanged and continue to be enforced by the safe GUT runner.
